items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Bon Bon was singing up there, too, with me.

ctx.x: We did a few shows. We went out and played (inaudible) quite a few theaters. And then Bon, he was married to a very wealthy girl, and she decided she didn't want him traveling. And he didn't show up at the Parlor, and they sued him and he quit and he paid off and paid his musicians off, and that's what broke that band up.. His wife
wouldn't let him go any further.
